text:
Anya Patel: Quick sync — I'm drafting a "shipability" checklist for the upcoming feature. Need agreements on SLA, docs, observability, and pricing comms. TL;DR: what must be green before we flip the switch?
Jason Li: +1. Can you list the minimum measurable gates?
Anya Patel: Thinking minimal gates: 1) SLA target defined and owned, 2) onboarding docs + quickstart, 3) tracing + perf dashboards, 4) rollback & canary plan, 5) pricing guidance for customers, 6) runbook for oncall.
Priya Raman: For docs: quickstart + migration note + feature flag guide. I can draft quickstart if owners and example requests provided.
Devon Clarke: Observability: we need p50/p95/p99 latency dashboards, token-cost per route, error-rate alerts (>= 1% 10m), and a smoke runbook with synthetic checks. Who owns traces?
Jason Li: Eng owns traces/metrics. I'll add the model route traces and spike detectors. Devon — can you write alert thresholds?
Devon Clarke: Yes. Proposed alerts: `error_rate > 1% over 10m`, `p99 latency > 500ms over 5m`, `token_cost_per_minute > 2x baseline`. OK?
Kai Morrison: Pricing note: we need recommended billing tiers and an internal per-token cost estimate for both hosted and dedicated. Also a short blurb for sales on how to explain burst vs reserved throughput.
Anya Patel: Good call. Kai — can you provide a 1-pager by EOD Thursday?
Kai Morrison: I can do a draft. Need expected QPS profile and average tokens per call. Jason — can you supply sample telemetry?
Jason Li: Will export a week of synthetic traffic by EOD today. Also adding a typical payload sample to help docs + cost calc.
Priya Raman: Once I have sample requests I can author the quickstart and a short troubleshooting FAQ. Prefer a single page + code snippet.
Anya Patel: Rollout plan idea: 1) internal beta with 2 customers, 2) automated canary (10% traffic) for 48h, 3) monitor, then 100% with 24h watch. Owners: Prod-Eng (canary), SRE (monitoring), Support (customer comms). Agree?
Devon Clarke: Sounds good. Add automatic fallback to cheaper model variant on latency spikes. Also add a circuit-breaker alert to trigger rollback.
Jason Li: We'll expose a routing policy flag to enable fallback. Need product decision on thresholds for fallback.
Anya Patel: Decision: fallback at p99 > 750ms for two consecutive 5m windows or error_rate > 2% over 10m. Can we implement?
Jason Li: Yes, engineering can implement that policy and wire the flag into rollout.
Priya Raman: Support & docs asks: include a short status template for Support to use when customers report issues; link to runbook. I can author the template.
Kai Morrison: Commercial nuance: for pilot customers we might offer temporary discounts if we hit stability issues. Need legal-signed clause — I'll loop in legal after draft.
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: scheduled canary deployment created for feature/shipability at 2024-05-18T14:00Z — will rotate 10% traffic for 48h.
Anya Patel: Outstanding action items: Jason -> traffic sample + routing flag PR; Priya -> quickstart + status template; Devon -> alerts + runbook; Kai -> pricing 1-pager; Jason+Devon -> canary + fallback tests. Will reconvene Thu 16:00 PT.
Jason Li: Added tasks to eng board.
Devon Clarke: I'll prototype synthetic smoke test and post results in #eng-sre.
Priya Raman: I'll post draft docs to the docs review thread and @Anya when ready.
Anya Patel: Thanks all — goal: shipability checklist in checklist format in the repo by Friday. If anything blocks, mention it here. :thumbsup:
Jason Li: Noted.
Kai Morrison: Noted.
Priya Raman: Noted.
